paragraphs: Vitamin C is an essential vitamin that’s an important part of a healthy diet, especially for children. California Gold Nutrition® Kids Liquid Vitamin C makes it easy for kids to get their daily dose of vitamin C, which can help support the immune system.*

California Gold Nutrition® Kids Liquid Vitamin C is formulated with our Gold C™, a USP grade vitamin C that is quality tested to meet strict specifications. It is a great tasting and convenient way to add more vitamin C to your child’s diet!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Children 4 years and older take 1 teaspoon daily, with or without food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional. Shake well before use. Give directly or mix with your child's favorite drink.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture. After opening, keep bottle tightly closed.
Best if used within 90 days of opening.
Note: Slight color shift may occur over time. This is a normal occurrence and cannot be avoided.
